ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 95:5 ratio of low-intensity (dark-grey/black) to high-intensity (white/yellow) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark low-intensity field across the primary fluke surface; high-contrast mottled geometric clusters localized at the left and right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serration consisting of approximately 9 deep vertical gouges across the continuous margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward trajectory of both distal lobes relative to the central waterline.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured light-colored pixel clusters at both distal tips consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical linear pixel disruptions corresponding to deep tissue loss along the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive repetitive tissue loss and deep scalloping across the entire visible trailing edge margin.
